stem: A company's sales of product P rose from 2 lakh to 3 lakh, while its total sales rose from 10 lakh to 20 lakh. Which choice best shows (i) the rise in P's absolute sales and (ii) the fall in P's share of total sales?
options: Pie charts for (i); a bar chart for (ii)
A bar chart for (i); pie charts for (ii)
A bar chart for both (i) and (ii)
explanation: Correct option: (C). Bar charts compare absolute values at discrete points, so they show P rising from 2 lakh to 3 lakh. Pie charts depict relative share: P's share falls from 2/10 = 20% to 3/20 = 15%, which two pies show directly. Pies alone hide the absolute rise, and bars alone do not show the change in share of the whole.
